name: Gauche
source:
One of the three siblings who serve Jean in the "Goddess Church". He is a cloned human being.

Good relationship with his origin, Miryu. He has a habit of wanting to tie everything to his hard work.

"Leave the hard work to me!"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
